method: leave-one-year-out over 2012-2019; MODIS (Terra+Aqua) -> S-NPP on matched days, vegetation fires

burned_area.note: Vegetation-fire hotspots per km2 burned (MODIS MCD64CMQ), 2001-2019, by GFED basis region. step2012 compares 2012-2015 with 2008-2011. Burned area has no sensor change in 2012, so a consistent hotspot record keeps the ratio flat apart from real changes in how fires burn; raw MODIS shows that real change.

creams.source: ICAR-IARI CREAMS crop residue burning bulletins, https://creams.iari.res.in/?page_id=1123
creams.note: CREAMS counts residue-burning events with its own protocol (cropland, its satellite mix), so absolute numbers differ from FIRMS; compare timing and season-to-season changes.
